home.title: Cortex
home.intro: Governed memory for the work your agents do: the rules your teams approve, the cases they resolved, and the evidence behind every answer.

desk.title: Decision Desk
desk.body: Review what Cortex learned from your specialists, with its evidence, and approve or reject it.

rules.title: Approved rules, one copy
rules.body: Every rule has an owner, a version and an effective date. Your rule engine and your AI read the same copy.

audit.title: Evidence for every answer
audit.body: Each answer cites the rules it used, with their version and approver, for your audit trail.

desk.title: Decision Desk
desk.intro: Read what Cortex learned, with its evidence, and approve or reject it. Only the named owner or backup of a scope can decide.
desk.pick: Pick a case to review it.

toolbar.label: Filters
toolbar.devNote: Dev only: the person you act as is sent as X-End-User-Id. In production it comes from your session.

detail.erased: This proposal was erased: its text can no longer be read.
detail.loosens: This rule would loosen an inherited {enforcement} rule, which keeps winning when packs are built: 「{text}」 ({targets})
detail.loosensErased: This rule would loosen an inherited {enforcement} rule whose text was erased ({targets})

provenance.model: Drafted by the model {model} from case(s) {cases}, corrected by {correctors}
provenance.policy: Drafted by the pack's rule from case(s) {cases}, corrected by {correctors}
provenance.importAuthority: Asked for authority {requested}; an import is capped at {cap} until you decide

decide.label: Decide on this case
decide.title: Your decision
decide.validityHint: Dates are business dates in Japan. Change them only if this rule should apply for a different period.
decide.authorityHint: Proposed at {proposed}. Machines and imports propose at 10 at most; approved rules usually carry 20 (team) to 30 (group). Higher wins between defaults.

notice.approved: Approved. The rule now applies to the next matching case.

expiring.title: Expiring soon
expiring.intro: Approved rules in this scope whose validity ends within {days} days.
expiring.empty: Nothing expires in the next {days} days.

bulk.hint: As proposed, one decision per case. Open a case to change its enforcement, authority or dates.

alerts.title: Needs your attention
alerts.intro: Approved rules in this scope to look at: ending within {days} days, due a review, often overridden, or losing to other rules.
alerts.renewed: {proposed} renewal(s) sent to the review queue; {refused} refused.

kind.often_overridden: Specialists corrected {count} cases where it applied (90 days)
kind.keeps_losing: Lost to another rule in {count} packs (90 days)

preview.appliesTo: Once approved, it applies to every case where
preview.title: What changes for {case}
preview.notApplicable: With these settings it would not apply to {case}.
preview.unavailable: No case was kept for this proposal, so there is nothing to preview.

shell.footer: Cortex proof of concept · arbitr · synthetic data only

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Choose your company and who you are.
login.note: Proof-of-concept sign-in: there is no password. In production you sign in with your company's single sign-on.
